requirements.request: City × award × original activity × observed quarter
requirements.available: National: 7,225 administering-city rows and 19,140 responsible-city rows; Texas: 0 and 1,220. Roles overlap. The 4,440-row selected QPR panel remains separate. The expanded Springfield pilot contains 508 listed activity-quarter rows; 155 are absent from both the earlier pilot and general QPR panel.
requirements.remaining: Government relationships are not beneficiary-city allocations. Springfield has 24 approved QPRs across 46 award quarters; 2013Q4 and 2019Q4–2024Q4 were not located in checked indexes. Source-listed activity headers are not proof of complete history, and missing is not zero.

requirements.available: All 128,382 national and 6,518 Texas source rows preserve the five signed quarterly financial measures, IDs and period. Independent QPR budgets and cumulative values retain source pages and vintages.
requirements.remaining: F31 has no compatible city/activity allocation history. QPR allocated activity budget can include program income; it is not initial grant award or borough allocation.

requirements.request: Award start, disaster/year and DR/MIT/NDR cohort
requirements.available: Original IDs, reported disaster/year and cohort travel with exports. Initial execution verified for 28 of 206 national awards, plus supplementary QPR-only Joplin; no Texas award start verified.
requirements.remaining: 178 national dates are unverified or unresolved, including Dauphin conflicting date labels. Grant year, disaster date and later effective-date snapshots are not substituted. Joplin’s first-round 2012 effective and signature dates conflict and remain unresolved.

requirements.available: 65 QPRs / 27 awards: 2,631 approved activity E/O and 2,698 activity E/allocated-budget values. Whole-grant E/O: 23 at Q4, 23 at Q12, 11 at Q20. Q4 E/total allocation: Moore, Minot, New Orleans, Springfield and supplementary Joplin. Source and denominator vintages are exported. A separate Springfield pilot provides QPR activity E/O at 7/18/25 and E/reported activity budget at 11/18/25 Q4/Q12/Q20 activity identities; it overlaps prior results and includes linked extensions.
requirements.remaining: F31 opening cumulative histories are unreconciled; its six certified outcomes remain blank. Q1 is the execution calendar quarter and may be partial; horizons are not exact anniversaries. Springfield activity budgets can include program income. Separate descriptive QPR total-funds / reported-award ratios are available; certified federal-only Q12/Q20 allocation outcomes remain unavailable.
